title: AI Image Production Specialist (Native Ads) — Remote, Part-Time to Full-Time Opportunity
description:
Be Better Advertising is a performance-driven digital advertising company. We run paid campaigns across multiple traffic sources and geographies. Our creative pipeline is already built and running. We need someone to run it well, day in and day out.



This is not a creative-from-scratch role. The angles, the projects, the prompts, the reference library, the workflow: all built. Your job is to execute that pipeline cleanly, catch what doesn't look right before it goes out, and grow into owning more of the creative output over time.



You'll start with images, then expand into headlines and advertorial copy as you prove you can consistently hit the standard. If you do your best work when the system is clear, the target is defined, and you take pride in hitting a number without being chased, read on.





→ THE WORK

• Produce native ad images through our Claude → Weavy pipeline (training provided)

• Follow the process exactly: study the reference, generate concept-first drafts, submit for approval, generate finals

• Quality control every image: does the product render correctly, on the right object, in a scene that makes sense? This reasoning is the most important part of the job.

• Write headlines using our AI-assisted framework

Refresh underperforming campaigns with new creatives

• Manage your projects in Trello, our CRM, with clean handoffs

• As you grow: deeper ownership of advertorial copy and content





→ THE TARGET

• Start: 20 image cards per week (~5/day), roughly 1 hour per card, tightening as you get faster

• Then: images + headlines as you master the pipeline





→ WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• A sharp eye. You instantly spot when a generated image is off: warped product, wrong object, nonsensical scene. This is the #1 skill.

• Speed and consistency. You'd rather hit 20 clean cards every week than chase a perfect one.

• Copywriting instinct. You can write a headline that makes someone stop and click.

• Comfort with AI tools. You've used AI image generation (any tool) and pick up new software fast. Execution matters here.

• You ship without being chased.





→ WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

• Not a creative director role. You're not inventing angles or strategy, we've built that.

• Not graphic design. No Photoshop artistry required, this is prompt-driven generation plus judgment.

• Not campaign or ad-platform management (our Campaign Coordinator takes care of that).





→ PAY & PATH

• $7.50/hr, ~20 hrs/week.

• Reliable weekly output opens the door to more hours and expanded scope (up to 40 hrs/week).

• Clear KPIs, a check-in cadence, and honest feedback. We're transparent about targets, and we tell you where you stand.





→ HOW TO APPLY

• Your CV

• A 2-4 minute video: your experience with AI-generated creative assets (images, headlines, copy), and an example of work you're proud of.

• 2–3 examples of AI images you've generated



We review every application. If you're a fit, we'll be in touch with next steps.

title: Video Editor
description:
WE’RE HIRING: VIDEO EDITOR



Full-Time | Work From Home | Philippines



I’m looking for a creative, fast and reliable Video Editor to join our team.



I’ll be producing the raw footage.



Your job is to take that footage and turn it into high-quality YouTube videos and short-form Reels that people actually want to watch.



WHAT YOU’LL BE EDITING



YouTube Videos



* Approx. 15 to 20 minute finished videos

* Talking-head and educational content

* Strong hooks and pacing

* Clean cuts

* B-roll

* On-screen text

* Graphics and visual callouts

* Music and sound effects where appropriate

* Zooms, punch-ins and pattern interrupts

* Simple diagrams or visuals to help explain concepts



The goal is NOT over-edited YouTube content.



I want videos that feel natural, fast-moving, interesting and personality-led.



Reels / Short-Form Content



* Turn raw footage and YouTube content into short-form videos

* Find the strongest hooks and moments

* Edit vertical 9:16

* Add captions and on-screen text

* Keep the pacing tight

* Create multiple pieces of content from longer footage



YOUR ROLE



I don’t want to have to tell you where every cut should go.



I want an editor who can watch the raw footage, understand the story and make good creative decisions.



You should be able to think:



“This section is too slow.”



“This needs a visual here.”



“That sentence would make a great Reel.”



“We should cut this completely.”



You’ll work closely with me and our existing marketing and design team.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You need to:



* Have proven experience editing YouTube videos

* Be excellent at short-form/Reels editing

* Understand retention, hooks and pacing

* Have strong English comprehension

* Understand storytelling, not just video editing

* Be confident working with raw talking-head footage

* Be able to create simple graphics and visual explanations

* Have excellent attention to detail

* Meet deadlines consistently

* Take feedback without needing the same feedback twice

* Be proactive and organised

* Be comfortable working as part of a remote team



SOFTWARE



You should be highly confident using professional video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or equivalent.



Experience with tools like CapCut, Canva and AI editing tools is also useful.



IMPORTANT



This is not a freelance gig.



We’re looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of our team.



We have a large team based in the Philippines, and many of our team members have been with us for 5+ years.



We value people who are reliable, loyal, good at what they do and want to grow with us.



If you are planning to take this position as a second full-time job, please do not apply.



We need someone who is available and committed during their agreed working hours.



TO APPLY



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your video editing experience

3. Links to 3 YouTube videos you personally edited

4. Links to 3 Reels/short-form videos you personally edited

5. The editing software you use

6. Your expected monthly salary

7. Your current availability

8. A short video interview introducing yourself. Tell me who you are, your experience as an editor, the type of content you love editing and why you think you’d be a great fit for our team.



 SUBJECT LINE



You must use the following subject line:



StefysVideoEditor26



Applications without this subject line or without a video introduction will not be considered.

title: Elementary Music Illustrator
description:
Thank you for your interest in this role!



This position supports an online curriculum platform for elementary music teachers. The business creates curriculum materials, lesson plans, teaching resources, and professional development for general music educators.



This role focuses specifically on **creating original illustrations and visual assets from ideas, source material, and creative direction**. You will work with me to turn educational ideas and raw materials into polished illustrations and graphics that feel cohesive, thoughtful, and distinctly on-brand.



The brand look is inspired by **Rifle Paper Co., Anthropologie, and Montessori**. The visual style is warm, sophisticated, educational, and thoughtfully designed.



A willingness to learn the brand deeply and study existing content is essential. You will be expected to notice patterns across previous work and carry those patterns into new illustrations and visual assets.



If you have strong creative judgment, excellent attention to detail, a sharp eye for visual design, and the ability to take an idea and figure out how to turn it into a finished visual, you'll thrive here!



**Work Vibe:**



This position requires a high level of creative thinking, attention to detail, and independent judgment. However, it is imperative to me that all team members enjoy their work. Expect a positive work environment with extremely high standards.



You will have flexibility in creating your own schedule and completing work during the hours that fit your workflow. Projects will be assigned with clear deadlines, and I expect work to be completed accurately and early, or at the very latest, by the deadline.



I am looking for someone who wants to become deeply familiar with the brand and take pride in making the work better over time.



Salary increases will follow a consistent schedule and will be based on job performance. You’ll know ahead of time what I’m looking for at each increase, that way you can move toward your desired hourly rate.



--------------------------------------------



**RESPONSIBILITIES**



### 1. Educational Illustration



* Create original illustrations for curriculum materials, teaching resources, social media, and other educational content

* Take educational ideas, written descriptions, sketches, and creative direction and translate them into clear, engaging illustrations

* Create illustrations that communicate music education concepts, classroom activities, movement directions, game formations, and teaching concepts

* Develop visual solutions that make educational information easier and more engaging for elementary music teachers

* Adapt illustrations for different formats and uses while maintaining visual consistency

* Create original visual assets that can be used across multiple pieces of content



### 2. Graphic Design and Visual Development



* Create polished graphics and visual assets for social media, website content, teaching materials, Google Slides, worksheets, and other curriculum resources

* Apply strong visual hierarchy, balance, alignment, composition, and typography

* Develop layouts that feel intentional and visually cohesive

* Create new visual treatments that feel consistent with the established brand rather than relying on generic templates

* Work from existing examples and established visual conventions when developing new materials

* Prepare finished artwork in the appropriate format for its intended use



### 3. Brand Consistency and Visual Development



* Study existing content and learn the visual patterns of the brand

* Apply established typography, spacing, layouts, colors, illustration styles, and other visual conventions consistently

* Maintain a cohesive visual identity across different types of materials

* Recognize when an illustration or design feels inconsistent with the established brand and make appropriate adjustments

* Develop new illustrations and visual treatments that expand the existing visual language while remaining recognizably on-brand

* Pay close attention to the relationship between illustrations, typography, layout, and surrounding content



### 4. Editorial Review and Attention to Detail



* Review all artwork carefully before submitting it for review

* Check spelling, typography, formatting, alignment, spacing, and proportions

* Ensure illustrations accurately reflect the creative direction and source material

* Compare new work with previous materials to maintain consistency

* Notice repeated visual elements, styles, or treatments across recent work

* Identify anything that looks unfinished, inconsistent, or out of place before it reaches me

* Take responsibility for delivering work that is fully reviewed and ready for use



### 5. Creative Thinking and Independent Judgment



* Make thoughtful creative decisions based on the goals of each project

* Work effectively from incomplete or informal creative direction

* Determine when an idea needs clarification and when a decision can reasonably be made independently

* Think critically about how an educational concept can be communicated visually

* Adapt quickly when creative direction changes

* Use previous work as a reference when making decisions about new illustrations

* Bring ideas and observations to the creative process rather than simply waiting for instructions



### 6. Collaboration and Implementation



* Work collaboratively to develop and implement planned projects

* Receive creative direction and translate concepts into finished illustrations and visual assets

* Communicate proactively about progress, questions, and potential blockers

* Ask thoughtful questions when additional information is genuinely needed

* Incorporate feedback efficiently and apply that feedback to future work

* Become increasingly independent as you learn the brand, workflow, and expectations



-----------------------------



**REQUIREMENTS**



You do not need to come into this role with a background in music education. However, you will be expected to learn the music terminology, notation, and pedagogy necessary to create accurate educational illustrations. This will be part of your onboarding and ongoing work.



Successful candidates have strong experience with **Adobe and/or Affinity products**, particularly for illustration and graphic design.



Most importantly, I'm looking for someone with **excellent creative judgment, strong visual taste, independent thinking, and an unusually high attention to detail.**



-------------------------------



**APPLICATION DIRECTIONS**



***IMPORTANT*** Only applications that follow directions will be read. Triple check your submission before sending it in.



Applications with 10 apply points or more will be prioritized. If there is a reason you cannot use 10 points, please explain it in the final paragraph of your application.



Send your application to

title: Senior Paid Media & Performance Marketing Manager (B2B SaaS)
description:
Summary

High Point International Inc. helps B2B SaaS executives build high-conviction growth engines. We are looking for an analytical, hands-on growth strategist to bridge the gap between ad spend and bottom-line revenue.



Mission



Drive scalable pipeline growth for B2B SaaS clients by executing full-funnel paid media campaigns and establishing closed-loop CRM attribution. You will solve tracking blind spots, optimize multi-channel performance, and deliver clear, data-backed acquisition strategies that translate marketing investments into qualified demos, pipeline, and predictable revenue.



What You'll Do



- Build, manage, and optimize multi-channel paid acquisition campaigns across Google Search, Demand Gen, LinkedIn, Meta, and emerging platforms like OpenAI Ads, Reddit, and CTV.



- Establish end-to-end tracking and attribution integrity using Google Tag Manager, GA4, UTM frameworks, and CRM integrations (HubSpot/Salesforce) to connect ad interactions directly to pipeline and revenue.



- Conduct continuous channel experimentation, evaluating new platforms for audience fit, cost efficiency, creative requirements, and measurement capabilities.



- Manage campaign mechanics including targeting, keyword strategy, bid structures, budget allocation, and continuous creative/landing page testing.



- Translate complex performance data into clear narrative reporting for executive stakeholders, highlighting CAC, opportunity creation, ROI, and strategic next steps.



- Collaborate cross-functionally with creative, content, and web teams to design high-converting ad assets and landing page experiences tailored to ICP decision-makers.



What Success Looks Like



- High-trust tracking environments established across clients, ensuring 100% data alignment between ad platforms, analytics tools, and CRM pipeline reports.



- Shift in focus from vanity metrics (clicks/leads) to full-funnel efficiency, resulting in reduced CAC and higher demo-to-opportunity conversion rates.



- Clear experimental roadmap active at all times, leading to early adoption of profitable new acquisition channels.



- Executive-ready reporting delivered regularly, providing clear recommendations on where to scale, optimize, or reallocate ad spend.



Nice to Have



- Hands-on experience with emerging ad platforms like OpenAI Ads, Reddit, or CTV.



- Deep familiarity with enterprise B2B sales cycles, ABM frameworks, and public sector/enterprise SaaS marketing.



- Advanced experience with offline conversion tracking and custom CRM data synchronization.



Logistics



- Location: Remote



- Work Style: Async / High-Ownership



- Weekly Hours: 20 hours/week



- Focus or Expectation: Full-funnel performance marketing, revenue attribution, and channel expansion for B2B SaaS.

title: Facebook Ads Video Editor
description:
We're looking for a video editor who understands one thing clearly:



A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for sleep, recovery, and natural pain relief, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for an editor who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, and other paid channels.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING ---



You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including: –
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases – UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly – Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action – Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof – VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure – Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



--- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ---



We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.



You should know how to edit videos that: – Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds – Make the problem feel real and urgent – Show the product clearly and persuasively – Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention – Feel native to
 and Instagram – Communicate benefits quickly and clearly – Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof – Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes... then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing.



--- THE KIND OF EDITOR WHO WILL THRIVE HERE ---



You'll be a strong fit if you: – Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands – Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative – Can create multiple ad variations quickly – Know how to follow references without copying them blindly – Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow – Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused – Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast – Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



--- SKILLS & EXPERIENCE ---



Ideally, you have experience with: – Meta/Facebook ad creatives – Short-form paid social videos – Long-form VSLs or sales videos – Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing – Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools



Bonus if you've worked with sleep, recovery, or natural pain relief.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY --- – Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references – Creating variations of winning ads for further testing – Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs – Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios – Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance – Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



--- WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU --- – $1,500 per month, full-time (40 hours per week), fully remote – Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives – The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue – Clear creative direction and fast feedback – Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively



We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for an editor who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.



If you're an e-commerce ad video editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.



--- HOW TO APPLY ---



All applications go through this form. It's the only way to be considered:







It takes about 10 minutes and requires a short video introduction. Applications sent as a message, without completing the form, will not be reviewed.

$6–$8 USD/hour | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time



Every day, dozens of cleaning appointments depend on someone noticing small scheduling problems before they become big ones.



We are looking for that person.



Maid In America Cleaning Services is hiring a highly organized Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant to coordinate mobile cleaning teams, maintain accurate operational data, and communicate with customers when schedules change.

-Notice small details and inconsistencies others miss

-Work quickly without sacrificing accuracy

-Enjoy solving scheduling and logistics problems

-Follow SOPs, checklists, and operating rules consistently

-Can investigate and solve routine problems independently

-Know when to stop and escalate a decision

-Communicate confidently and professionally with customers

-Stay calm when priorities change

-Learn new software quickly

-Take ownership of mistakes and correct them promptly



Experience

title: Product Image Specialist (Freelance)
description:
Context:

We're an e-commerce jewellery brand, and we're looking for a talented AI image creator to help bring our pieces to life for our upcoming launches.



The role:

We're looking for an experienced AI image specialist to create product images of our jewellery for our new launches. The bar is simple but high: the images must look like real, professional photo shoots.



What you'd create

Two kinds of images:



Product images: the jewellery on its own, on a clean background with soft, natural shadows. Elegant and true to the piece.

Model images: our jewellery worn by realistic-looking models, in natural, believable settings.

In both cases, the goal is simple: the images should look like real photos, not AI. That's really the heart of the role.



Who we're looking for

We're quite demanding on quality, so ideally you're someone independent: we give you clear guidelines, you get the brief, and you deliver at a high level without needing much back and forth. We also work in waves, so being able to produce fairly quickly is a real plus.



- Proven experience creating photorealistic, studio-quality AI product images (jewellery, fashion or small luxury goods is a big plus)

- A strong eye for lighting, materials, texture, realistic detail and composition

- Genuinely high resolution and high quality, every time

- Fast, reliable and able to produce volume during active periods



Portfolio required

Please include a portfolio when you apply. We can only review applications that show real examples of AI images you've already created, so we can see if your style and quality are a match. No examples, no review.



How it works

If your portfolio matches what we're looking for, we'll invite you to a paid test on one product. If it goes well, we'd love to work together on an ongoing, per-product basis.



Compensation

Paid per product, based on scope. Work comes in batches, so consistency and speed matter.



To apply, send us:



Your portfolio (with AI-generated images)

Your rate per product

Your typical turnaround time

We can't wait to see your work!

title: Administrative & Operations Coordinator
description:
Role Overview



We are looking for a proactive, organized, and collaborative Part-Time Virtual Assistant to provide administrative, operational, CRM, and general business support across the organization.



This role will work closely with leadership and different members of the team to help keep priorities organized, tasks moving, and important details from falling through the cracks.



Because this is a highly collaborative and people-focused company, we are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys working as part of a team. The ideal person does not work in isolation or limit themselves only to tasks assigned directly to them. They communicate, participate, share updates, offer help when appropriate, and look for ways to contribute to the team's overall success.



Key Areas of Responsibility

1. Administrative & Operational Support

Manage calendar reminders, appointments, meetings, and scheduling coordination.

Help ensure important commitments, deadlines, and follow-ups are not missed.

Track expenses, manage invoices, and assist with financial report submissions.

Retrieve, organize, and maintain receipts, invoices, and other business documentation.

Assist with travel arrangements, events, meetings, and other business logistics.

Provide general administrative support to keep day-to-day operations organized.

2. CRM Management & Data Organization

Maintain and update the CRM.

Keep contact information, lead records, tags, and other CRM data accurate and organized.

Import, clean, and organize data to improve database quality.

Track leads, follow-ups, tasks, and reminders within the CRM.

Identify opportunities to improve lead tracking, organization, and engagement.

3. Task Coordination & Follow-Through

Take meeting notes and clearly document action items and next steps.

Create and maintain task lists, reminders, calendar invites, and project follow-ups.

Follow through on assigned responsibilities and provide timely updates on progress.

Help ensure tasks do not get lost between meetings, conversations, or different team members.

Coordinate with operations, recruiting, marketing, leadership, and other functions as needed.

4. Reporting & Business Support

Assist with tracking important business metrics and activities.

Help prepare reports and structured updates for leadership.

Monitor information such as leads, activities, projects, and campaign progress.

Keep information organized so leadership and the team have visibility into what is happening.

5. Marketing & Light Creative Support

Assist with content organization, research, and basic marketing activities.

Support social media updates, analytics tracking, and content planning.

Assist with transcription of audio or video content and newsletter preparation when needed.

Conduct research on trends, content ideas, and potential marketing opportunities.

6. Customer & Client Administrative Support

Assist with collecting client feedback and coordinating review requests.

Help identify missing follow-ups or gaps in client communication.

Support administrative activities that contribute to an organized and positive client experience.

7. Cross-Team Collaboration & General Support

Work collaboratively with leadership and different areas of the business rather than operating independently from the team.

Participate in team conversations, meetings, and shared initiatives.

Communicate openly about progress, questions, challenges, and opportunities to help.

Provide administrative support across recruiting, operations, marketing, and leadership without necessarily owning those functions.

Help organize workflows, monitor deliverables, and maintain internal systems.

Step in and support teammates when appropriate and when priorities shift.

Identify inefficiencies and proactively suggest ways to improve processes and teamwork.

What We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



Highly collaborative and team-oriented – enjoys working with people, contributing to conversations, and being part of a shared goal.

Proactive – notices what needs attention and takes initiative instead of always waiting for instructions.

Organized and detail-oriented – able to manage multiple moving pieces without losing track of important details.

Reliable with follow-through – takes ownership of commitments and closes the loop.

Communicative – provides updates, asks questions, and raises concerns early.

Adaptable – comfortable supporting different areas of the business as priorities evolve.

People-focused – understands that relationships and teamwork are just as important as completing individual tasks.

Comfortable with technology – able to learn and work within CRM, project management, communication, and productivity tools.

Success in This Role



Success is not measured only by how many tasks are completed. We are looking for someone who becomes a trusted and engaged member of the team.



The right person will help keep the business organized while also building strong working relationships, communicating consistently, contributing ideas, supporting teammates, and taking shared ownership of the team's success.

title: Freelance Video Editor (Per Project) for Instagram Reels and YouTube
description:
About us



JB Marketing is a UK-based Google Ads agency working with Shopify ecommerce brands. Our founder creates video content for YouTube and Instagram: account teardowns, client results breakdowns, and short educational clips for ecommerce founders. We need a reliable editor to turn raw footage into finished videos.



What the work looks like



This is not a full-time or part-time role. Work comes in batches when we have footage ready, and there may be quiet weeks in between. Each project is paid individually at a rate we agree up front. If you want steady monthly hours, this is not the job for you. If you want flexible, well-paid project work alongside your other clients, read on.



You will be added to our Slack workspace. Project files (raw footage, screen recordings, any brand assets and notes) will be sent to you there, and you will send finished edits back the same way.



Typical projects:



Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts (30 to 90 seconds): cut from longer talking-head footage or screen recordings, add captions, hooks, simple motion graphics, b-roll and sound design. Usually 4 to 6 clips cut from one longer video.

YouTube videos (8 to 20 minutes): talking head plus screen recordings of Google Ads accounts and dashboards. Clean cuts, zoom-ins on the screen where it matters, captions, chapter titles, light music, consistent branding.

Occasional carousel or quote graphics from the same source footage (nice to have, not required).

Requirements

Proven experience editing short-form content (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) and long-form YouTube content. We need both.

Comfortable editing screen-recording heavy content and keeping it engaging (zooms, highlights, callouts).

Strong captioning skills. Clean, readable, correctly timed, no typos.

Good English comprehension so you can follow the narrative and cut for the message, not just the timestamps.

Own software (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut or similar) and a machine that can handle 1080p and 4K footage.

Reliable on Slack, responds within one working day, and delivers on the deadline you commit to.

Can take feedback and turn around revisions quickly.

Pay



Per project, paid in USD after delivery of each project (or in batches if we send several at once). Tell us your rates in your application for:



One short-form clip (Reel or Short) from provided footage

One long-form YouTube video (roughly 10 to 15 minutes)

A bundle: one long-form video plus 5 short clips cut from it



We are happy to pay well for quality and speed. We are not looking for the cheapest option.



How to apply



Applications without work samples will not be read. Please include:



Links to at least 3 short-form videos you edited (Reels, TikToks or Shorts). Talking head or educational content is a plus.

Links to at least 2 long-form YouTube videos you edited, ideally with screen recordings or tutorials in them.

Your per-project rates for the three items listed under Pay.

Your usual turnaround time for a short clip and for a long-form video.

The software you edit in.

Put the word "SECOND CHANNEL" at the top of your application so we know you read the full listing.



Short, clear applications are best. We will reply to shortlisted editors with one small paid test project before offering ongoing work.

title: AI Video Editor —  AI-Made Ads | DTC E-com | Long-Term
description:
AI Video Creative — DTC Brand



About the role 

We're a fast-scaling DTC e-commerce brand and all our video ads are made with AI, no cameras, no actors. You take a brief and turn it into ready-to-run ads at high speed, generating and editing everything with AI tools (a lot of it with Higgsfield / Nano Banana). One concept becomes multiple hook variations that we test and scale. This is a long-term role, not a one-off gig.



The two kinds of video you'll make

- UGC / avatar-style AI ads, AI creators and AI voice-overs, no real actors

- AI animation / motion ads



What you'll deliver (daily)

- New ad variations every working day, no hand-holding

- 3–5 fresh hooks/angles per winning concept

- First version same day, revisions within 24h

- A steady volume once you're ramped (we'll align on the weekly number)



Tools you live in

- AI video & image: Higgsfield (incl. Nano Banana), Runway, Kling, Sora etc.

- Audio & upscaling: ElevenLabs

- Edit: CapCut

- Comms & organisation: Notion + Slack (or similar)



How you work, this matters most

- Self-managing: you get a written brief and run with it. No call needed for every change.

- You think along: you actively suggest how to improve our creatives and our output,  you're a partner in making the work better, not just a pair of hands.

- Fast: speed is a core part of this role.

- You get direct response: you understand hooks, storytelling and conversion, you make ads that SELL, not just look nice.



Requirements

- Real experience with DTC/e-com video ads

- AI-native, you build with these tools every single day

- Reliable internet + able to overlap a few hours with European (CET) working hours

- Start your application with the word "HOOK" or it gets deleted



Not for

- Beginners or "design-only" profiles

- Slow executors who need a call for every change

DrayEasy Inc is a steadily developing international enterprise. We are seeking a versatile HR Specialist based in the Philippines to independently conduct full-cycle human resource operations. The HR Specialist will be in charge of end-to-end recruitment, personnel transfer & separation, performance management, one-on-one employee counseling, staff care, and training arrangements. Forget red tape and invisible busywork. In this role, you sit right alongside decision-makers. title: Shopify Product/collection Lister - Dropshipping Stores
description:
IMPORTANT: Start your application with a red apple emoji. Applications without it are not read.



WHAT THIS IS



We run multiple dropshipping stores across different markets and languages. We need someone to list products and full collections on our Shopify stores, correctly and consistently.



You will start with listing. Once you know our process and we know your work, this role grows into launching our Meta ad campaigns as well. That is a real next step, not a maybe. It is the second half of the same job and we would rather grow one person into it than hire twice.



Everything runs on a written SOP plus a Loom video that shows the whole process from start to finish. You will not be guessing.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Single products:

- Get a source product URL from us

- Request the import script in our Claude project and run it on your PC through Command Prompt (copy-paste, no coding needed)

- Send us the full output, including any errors

- Pull the size chart from the source, get it translated and converted to centimetres, then set it up in the Kiwi Sizing app and assign it to the product

- Check the live product page against our checklist



Full collections:

- Same process, but for an entire collection at once

- One size chart covers the whole collection, so you build it once and assign it to every product in that collection

- Check that the product count matches the source and that nothing was skipped



Quality control (this is the important part):

- Titles and colour names properly translated, no leftover words from the source language

- Correct photo showing for each colour variant

- Shoe sizes in EU, not US

- Prices and compare-at prices correct

- No leftover text from the source store: shipping promises, guarantees, city names, brand stories

- Size chart button appears on the product page with the right chart behind it



When something is wrong, you send us the product link and describe what you see. You never edit a script yourself.



WHAT YOU NEED



- Real experience listing products on Shopify. You have done this yourself, on live stores.

- Experience launching Meta ads. You will not use it on day one, but this is where the role goes.

- Experience with dropshipping stores specifically.

- You use Claude or ChatGPT as a working tool, not just occasionally.

- A Windows PC. Our import scripts only run on Windows.

- Very clear written English. All our communication is written. If we have to read a message twice to understand it, this will not work.

- Fast, stable internet.

- Flexible availability. You choose when you work your hours, but launches do not always fall inside office hours, so we need someone who can be reached and can pick up a task when it comes in.

- Attention to detail, and the discipline to follow a written process exactly instead of doing it your own way.



You will get access to our Shopify admin and an API token. We need someone we can trust with that.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



- Written SOPs and a Loom video walkthrough of the full process

- All accounts and tools you need

- Direct contact with us. Asking a question is always better than guessing.

- A clear path into launching our ad campaigns once you have the listing process down



HOW TO APPLY



Read this carefully. Applications that miss a step are not reviewed.



1. Start your message with a red apple emoji.

2. List the stores you have worked on. Names or URLs. Tell us what you did on each one: listing, ads, or both.

3. Answer these two questions:

   - How many products or collections have you listed in a typical week?

   - Which ad accounts have you worked in, and what did you launch?



We reply to everyone who does all three.
salary: 3-5 usd per hour based on experience

title: Meta Ads Specialist
description:
We are seeking an experienced and data-driven Full-Time Meta Ads Specialist to lead the strategy, execution, and optimization of all paid social advertising campaigns across Meta platforms 
, Instagram, Messenger) for a portfolio of diverse agency clients. This is a highly strategic, client-facing role that requires a mastery of performance marketing fundamentals combined with a strong creative intuition and a dedication to staying ahead of platform algorithm shifts.



The ideal candidate not only knows how to execute, but is also fluent in the latest AI-driven delivery systems, such as the Andromeda update, and understands the new imperative of creative diversification over hyper-specific audience targeting.



Key Responsibilities



I. Campaign Strategy & Optimization (The Science)



Client Performance Ownership: Plan, launch, manage, and scale high-performing campaigns across multiple client accounts and the entire marketing funnel (TOFU, MOFU, BOFU) to meet aggressive ROAS/CPA targets.



Advanced Targeting: Utilize a deep understanding of audience segmentation, including Custom Audiences, Lookalikes (LALs), and Advantage+ Audience parameters, to maximize signal density and conversion efficiency tailored to each client's unique target demographic.



Platform Expertise (Post-Andromeda): Structure campaigns for success in Meta’s evolving AI-driven environment. This includes consolidating campaign structures, embracing broad targeting, and leveraging Advantage+ automation tools for budget and placement optimization.



Tracking & Data Health: Ensure flawless implementation and maintenance of the Meta Pixel and Conversions API to ensure clean, high-quality data reporting and optimal ad delivery signals for every client property.



Budget Management: Rigorously monitor campaign spend, perform daily optimizations, and manage bids and budget allocations (CBO/Advantage+ Budget) to maximize efficiency and scale across your assigned client portfolio.



II. Creative Strategy & Storyboarding (The Art)



Creative as the New Targeting: Proactively lead the creative strategy, recognizing that ad creative is the primary lever for performance in the current Meta landscape.



Storyboarding & Visual Planning: Suggest, plan, and formalize storyboards and visual concepts for new ad creatives, focusing on mobile-first, vertical video (Reels/Stories) formats.



A/B Testing Discipline: Implement a rigorous, continuous creative testing framework (e.g., 8-15 distinct creative concepts per campaign) to consistently refresh the ad library and combat ad fatigue.



Collaboration: Serve as the critical bridge between the Media Buying team and the Content/Design teams, ensuring all visual and copy assets are briefed correctly, align with platform best practices, and address specific audience angles.



III. Reporting & Platform Intelligence



Client Analysis & Reporting: Analyze performance data daily, weekly, and monthly, translating complex metrics (e.g., CPM, CTR, ROAS, New Customer Ratio) into clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations for client presentations and internal stakeholders.



Innovation & Updates: Stay current with all major platform updates, policy changes, and algorithmic shifts (e.g., Andromeda, iOS updates). Implement necessary changes immediately to maintain account performance and compliance.



Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of all campaign setups, testing results, and optimization protocols.



Required Skills & Qualifications



3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience managing and scaling high-budget paid advertising campaigns on Meta platforms 
 and Instagram).



Proven ability to manage and prioritize multiple client accounts and diverse campaign objectives simultaneously, ideally within an agency setting.



Expert-level proficiency in Meta Ads Manager and Business Manager, including deep knowledge of setting up Conversion Tracking, Catalog Feeds, and Dynamic Ads.



Demonstrable understanding of AI-driven ad delivery changes and how to adapt strategy to new automated systems (e.g., the importance of creative density and broad targeting in the current ad auction environment).



Proven visual aptitude and creative thinking with experience outlining and briefing impactful ad concepts/storyboards for video and static formats.



Exceptional analytical skills, highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets, and the ability to interpret data beyond surface-level metrics.



Strong communication skills, capable of presenting complex performance data and creative rationale to stakeholders.



Meta Blueprint certification(s) strongly preferred.

title: Facebook Ads Video Editor
description:
We're looking for a video editor who understands one thing clearly:



A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for sleep, recovery, and natural pain relief, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for an editor who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, and other paid channels.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.





--- WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING ---



You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:



-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

- UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

- Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

- Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

- Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures





--- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ---



We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.



You should know how to edit videos that:



- Stop people in the first 1-3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

- Feel native to
 and Instagram

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes... then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing.





--- THE KIND OF EDITOR WHO WILL THRIVE HERE ---



You'll be a strong fit if you:



- Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Can create multiple ad variations quickly

- Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

- Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

- Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.





--- SKILLS & EXPERIENCE ---



Ideally, you have experience with:



- Meta/Facebook ad creatives

- Short-form paid social videos

- Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools



Bonus if you've worked with sleep, recovery, or natural pain relief.





--- WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY ---



- Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations





--- WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU ---



- $1,500 per month, full-time (40 hours per week), fully remote

- Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives

- The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback

- Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively



We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for an editor who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.



If you're an e-commerce ad video editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.





--- HOW TO APPLY ---



All applications go through this form. It's the only way to be considered:







It takes about 10 minutes and requires a short video introduction.



Applications sent as a message, without completing the form, will not be reviewed.

I do not need another video editor. Premiere, After Effects, "engaging and professional content" - that is not this job. I get twenty of those applications a week and I delete all of them.



I need someone who lives inside AI video models.



THE WORK

We make short-form ads for TikTok and YouTube Shorts. Up to 60 seconds. Every video is built from AI UGC clips, AI B-roll, sourced B-roll, AI voiceover, styled captions, and fast cuts in CapCut.



Per shift you deliver either:

- 5 to 7 finished videos, or

- up to 30 variants of videos that are already running (new first 3 seconds, new hook, swapped opening clip, new hook audio, different captions, different voice)



Most of them will fail. That is the point. We test volume to find the few that work, and then we hammer the winners with variants.



THE SHIFT

Friday, Saturday, Sunday, Monday. 4 days, 28 hours per week. $400/month. Remote.



WHAT I ACTUALLY WANT TO KNOW

title: Creative Production Coordinator - Meta Ads Agency
description:
**About the role**  

We are a creative agency that produces static ads for e‑commerce brands running Meta ad spend.



You will own every step between “a client assigns us a task” and “the finished ad is in the client’s hands.” You will not design the ads or write the copy. Your responsibility is to ensure the right work reaches the right designer, returns correctly, and ships on time, every time.



We promise clients **48 hours** on a new task and **24 hours** on a revision. Your job is to keep that promise.



---



### What you will own  



- **Intake** – Monitor every place clients assign work (ClickUp, Notion, Airtable, Slack,
). No request sits unnoticed for more than 4 business hours.  

- **Brief capture** – Copy each client brief into our standard Notion card, word for word, including every reference image. Never paraphrase or summarize.  

- **Verification** – Before a card is sent out:  

  - Check prices against the live price sheet.  

  - Attach the correct product file.  

  - Verify banned words are excluded.  

  - Apply past client corrections.  

- **Dispatch** – Assign cards to designers, balance the load across the team, and chase any item that has not moved in 12 hours.  

- **Quality check** – Review every finished ad to ensure:  

  - Correct product is used.  

  - Approved copy is pasted (not retyped).  

  - Safe zones are correct for each size.  

  - Export settings and file naming are accurate.  

- **Delivery** – Post finished ads to the client on their platform, in our voice, and log the delivery.  

- **Revisions** – Capture client feedback word for word, set the deadline, and route it back to a designer within 24 hours.  

- **Reporting** – Send one short status message to the founder each morning; provide weekly numbers.  

- **SOPs** – If a question is asked twice, write it into the SOP.



---



### What this job is **not**  



- You do **not** choose the reference ads; you may suggest but never d
.  

- You do **not** write or rewrite ad copy.  

- You do **not** design. If a designer is unavailable, you reassign; you do not open Figma to fix it.  

- You do **not** handle pricing, scope, or strategy conversations with clients.  



If you are hoping this role will evolve into a creative or copywriting position, it is not the right fit.



---



### What we need from you  



- **2 + years** in project coordination, production management, or creative operations (agency experience preferred; paid social or e‑commerce strongly preferred).  

- **Notion** at a power‑user level: you have personally run a board with real statuses, relations, and filtered views, the core of the job.  

- Working knowledge of **ClickUp** and **Airtable**: you can open a client’s board, find the task, and read the brief without breaking anything.  

- Excellent written English: your messages go to clients under our name.  

- Obsessive attention to detail: noticing a $3 price discrepancy or an outdated bottle label is essential. If detail work drains you, please do not apply.  

- Ability to follow a written process exactly; when something is unclear, ask one short question, never guess.  

- Comfort with AI tools and willingness to learn ours; we run Claude inside our workflow daily, and you will use it.



#### Nice to have  



- Enough **Figma** or **Canva** experience to judge safe zones and export settings.  

- Experience onboarding freelancers or managing a small remote team.  

- Experience working to a service‑level agreement and understanding the pressure of a running clock.



---



### How to apply  



Send us:



1. A short note on the production process you have personally run, include the steps, number of people involved, and how you kept track.  

2. A description of a what tools you used and managed?   

3. Your answer to this scenario: *A client brief says the product is the 60‑capsule bottle, but the product folder only has the 30‑capsule image. What do you do?*



**Start your application with the word `CONVEYOR`** so we know you read the whole post. 



All applications which dont answer the above questions and don't use the keyword will not be considered.

title: Motion Designer Figma
description:
About the Role



We're a boutique branding studio based in the Netherlands. We work at the intersection of brand identity, strategy, and design execution. Our brand and design work is built in Figma, and we're now bringing that work to life in motion for social and beyond.



We're looking for a skilled motion designer to join us on a gig basis, with a clear path toward part-time and eventually full-time collaboration for the right person. Our graphic designer and creative lead design everything in Figma. Your job is to take those finished designs and turn them into motion: animated brand content, kinetic typography, logo reveals, and explainer graphics that feel as considered as the brands we build.



This is not an entry-level role, and it is NOT for someone who just started animating and is looking to grow into the work. We need someone who has already done this at a high level, repeatedly, and can prove it with published work.



What You'll Do



- Receive briefs via online meeting, written documentation, and finished Figma design files, then independently own the animation from static design to final motion

- Create animated brand content for social: kinetic typography, quote and statement reels, framework and process explainers, announcement and case-study pieces

- Produce logo animations, brand reveals, intros, outros, and motion stings from our identity systems

- Translate Figma designs faithfully into motion, respecting the original layout, type, and spacing

- Build reusable, editable animated templates so our best formats can be repeated across campaigns and clients

- Design transitions and motion polish, and add animated graphic layers where needed

- Deliver organised, well-structured project files (clean comps, logical naming, reusable pre-comps) and export to the correct specs for social (9:16) and web



What This Role Is Not



This is not primarily a footage-editing or videography role. We're after animated design, moving type, graphics, and brand motion built from our Figma work, not cutting and grading filmed clips. If you also edit footage, that's a bonus, but it is not the core of this role.



It's not for someone who only assembles presets or templates without understanding brand logic. We provide brand deliverables and expect motion that feels intentional, not generic default animation.



And it's not for someone who needs constant hand-holding. You receive the brief, ask the right questions upfront, and deliver, with proactive communication if questions come up.



What We're Looking For



Required:



- A strong showreel and portfolio of published motion design work that shows real craft in kinetic type, brand animation, and graphic motion. We will be looking at it critically

- Expert-level After Effects. This is the core tool of the role

- Excellent kinetic typography. You can animate type in a specific brand typeface so it feels designed, not defaulted

- The ability to work from Figma design files and translate static layouts faithfully into motion

- A strong sense of timing, easing, and pacing. Your animation should feel premium and considered, never stiff or templated

- Clean working habits: organised comps, logical naming, reusable pre-comps, editable project files

- Reliable communication in English, written and spoken

- Able to work independently from a brief with minimal back-and-forth



Nice to have:



- A templated, systematic way of working. You structure and document your files so our best formats become repeatable, as we intend to systematise our content

- Illustrator experience and comfort preparing or adapting vector assets

- Lottie or web-export experience, and familiarity with motion for digital products

- A sense for sound, syncing motion to audio

- Editing ability (Premiere) for the occasional mixed piece

- Prior agency or brand content experience



How We Work Together



Every project starts with a briefing call where we walk you through the use case, goals, and brand direction. After the call, we provide written documentation and the finished Figma design files. From there, you own the animation. We expect proactive communication if questions come up. No silence until delivery.



Compensation



This starts as a gig engagement, paid hourly, based on experience and portfolio. We pay well for the right person. Strong collaborators will have the opportunity to move into a structured part-time role, and eventually a full-time position as the relationship grows.



How to Apply



Send us:



- Your showreel and portfolio, links to published, live motion work only. No unlisted mockups or static frames. We want to see what you've actually shipped

- A short introduction: your background, the types of projects you've worked on, the tools you're expert in, and your hourly rate expectation



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a paid test project, one short motion piece animated from a real Figma brief, before we move forward. Applications without a showreel will not be reviewed.

Audit client credit reports and build the dispute strategy

Draft and send dispute letters to bureaus and furnishers

Track rounds, deadlines, and results inside our system

Log deletions and update client files accurately

Report your numbers weekly



REQUIREMENTS



3+ years credit repair disputing experience, provable

Strong written English

Reliable computer and backup internet

Available Monday to Friday during EST business hours

Available to start immediately



HOW TO APPLY



Applications that skip any step get deleted without a reply. This is the filter.



(1) Put the word DELETE at the top of your message. No code word, no response.



(2) Tell me exactly how many years you have been disputing and who you did it for.

title: Part-Time Social Media & Brand Coordinator-Please read 10 steps to apply
description:
**Remote | 15–20 Hours per Week | Long-Term Opportunity**



We are seeking a creative, organized, and brand-conscious Social Media & Brand Coordinator to manage the social media presence of two growing brands:



* **Elevation Individual and Family Therapy** — a multi-location mental health practice serving individuals, couples, families, and children.

* **Calm and Capable CEO (CCC)** — a personal brand focused on leadership, entrepreneurship, faith, business systems, and building a successful therapy practice without constant chaos.



This is not simply a posting position. We need someone who can understand the distinct voice and audience of each brand, turn ideas and raw content into polished posts, maintain a consistent publishing schedule, evaluate performance, and proactively recommend content that supports each brand’s goals.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Social Media Strategy and Planning



* Develop and maintain a monthly social media strategy for both brands.

* Create organized weekly and monthly content calendars.

* Recommend content topics based on brand goals, audience needs, current trends, seasonal opportunities, and performance data.

* Identify appropriate trends, sounds, formats, keywords, and content opportunities without forcing trends that do not fit the brand.

* Balance educational, relatable, promotional, community-building, and authority-building content.

* Recommend campaigns to increase engagement, website traffic, client inquiries, followers,
 subscribers, and brand awareness.

* Repurpose strong-performing content into new formats and across platforms.

* Monitor relevant competitors and industry trends to identify content gaps and opportunities.



### Content Creation and Editing



* Turn raw videos, voice notes, photographs, written ideas, and longer recordings into polished social media content.

* Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
, YouTube Shorts, and other appropriate platforms.

* Add captions, on-screen text, transitions, branding, music, and calls to action.

* Create branded carousels, graphics, quote posts, stories, thumbnails, and other visual content.

* Write captions, hooks, headlines, calls to action, hashtags, and platform-appropriate descriptions.

* Maintain consistent colors, fonts, visual style, messaging, and tone for each brand.

* Adapt content appropriately for each platform instead of publishing identical content everywhere.

* Help organize and maintain a searchable content library containing raw footage, edited content, graphics, captions, and reusable brand assets.



### Publishing and Community Management



* Schedule and publish approved content accurately and on time.

* Ensure links, tags, locations, cover images, captions, and calls to action are correct before publishing.

* Maintain a consistent posting schedule across all assigned platforms.

* Monitor comments, messages, mentions, and audience engagement.

* Respond to general comments and messages using approved brand guidelines.

* Escalate clinical questions, complaints, negative feedback, media inquiries, partnership opportunities, and sensitive messages to leadership.

* Engage thoughtfully with relevant accounts and communities to increase organic visibility.

* Assist with maintaining updated bios, profile links, highlights, pinned posts, and platform information.



### Analytics and Optimization



* Review platform analytics weekly and monthly.

* Track reach, views, watch time, retention, engagement, follower growth, link clicks, inquiries, conversions, and other relevant metrics.

* Identify which topics, hooks, formats, and posting times perform best.

* Provide a concise monthly report explaining:



  * What performed well

  * What underperformed

  * Why the results may have occurred

  * What should be repeated, changed, or tested next

* Use performance data to improve future content rather than relying only on personal preference.

* Conduct simple A/B tests of hooks, covers, captions, calls to action, and content formats.

* Track content progress from idea through approval, scheduling, publication, and reporting.



## Brand-Specific Expectations



### Elevation Individual and Family Therapy



Content should feel professional, compassionate, inclusive, trustworthy, and accessible. It should help potential clients understand therapy, connect with the practice, learn about services, and feel comfortable taking the next step.



The coordinator must understand the importance of privacy when working with a mental health organization. No client information, testimonials, identifying details, or clinical content may be used without explicit authorization. Content must never diagnose followers, promise treatment outcomes, or provide individualized clinical advice.



### Calm and Capable CEO



Content should feel confident, polished, relatable, honest, encouraging, faith-aware, and practical. It should reflect the voice of a successful therapy practice owner who shares real lessons about leadership, systems, staffing, growth, and becoming a calmer CEO.



The coordinator must be able to preserve the founder’s natural voice rather than making the content sound generic, overly corporate, or AI-generated.



## Platforms May Include



* Instagram

*

* TikTok

* LinkedIn

* YouTube Shorts

* Pinterest

* Google Business Profile

*
 or blog content repurposing when needed



Experience with every platform is not required, but you should be able to explain which platforms you have managed and what results you achieved.



## Required Qualifications



* At least two years of professional social media management, content creation, or digital marketing experience.

* A strong portfolio showing social media graphics, carousels, short-form video editing, branding, and caption writing.

* Demonstrated understanding of branding, visual consistency, audience positioning, and brand voice.

* Strong short-form video editing and graphic-design skills.

* Excellent written English, grammar, communication, and proofreading skills.

* Ability to create distinct content for two different brands without blending their voices or visual identities.

* Experience using analytics to improve content strategy.

* Strong organization, attention to detail, and deadline management.

* Ability to work independently, communicate proactively, and ask questions when expectations are unclear.

* Ability to receive feedback and make revisions without becoming defensive.

* Reliable internet connection and dependable computer.

* Willingness to sign confidentiality and intellectual-property agreements.

* Ability to protect confidential business information and follow privacy requirements.



## Preferred Experience



* Experience with mental health, healthcare, wellness, coaching, entrepreneurship, or personal brands.

* Familiarity with HIPAA-sensitive or highly confidential environments.

* Experience growing service-based business accounts organically.

* Experience creating content designed to generate inquiries, leads, or appointments.

* Familiarity with tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Metricool, Meta Business Suite, Later, Buffer, Google Drive, ChatGPT, or similar platforms.

* Experience with basic SEO, social-search optimization, YouTube keywords, and Google Business Profile content.

* Experience supporting a founder who provides raw ideas or footage and needs someone to turn them into finished content.

* Basic understanding of paid social media campaigns is a plus but not required.



## What Success Looks Like



The right person will:



* Keep both brands posting consistently without frequent reminders.

* Learn and maintain the voice and visual identity of each brand.

* Bring thoughtful content recommendations instead of waiting for every idea to be assigned.

* Turn raw content into polished, engaging, brand-aligned posts.

* Catch errors before content is published.

* Use analytics to make specific recommendations.

* Maintain an organized calendar and content-production system.

* Communicate early when content, approvals, or information are needed.

* Help Elevation generate greater community visibility and qualified client inquiries.

* Help Calm and Capable CEO grow an engaged audience and establish strong thought leadership.



## Schedule and Work Arrangement



* Part-time: approximately 15–20 hours per week.

* Long-term remote opportunity.

* Flexible working hours, with some availability required during U.S. Central Time for meetings, communication, and approvals.

* Participation in a weekly content-planning or progress meeting may be required.

* Additional hours may become available as the brands grow and performance is demonstrated.



## Compensation



Compensation is based on experience, portfolio quality, and demonstrated skill. Please include your desired hourly or monthly rate in your application.



## How to Apply



To be considered, submit all of the following:



1. A current resume.

2. A portfolio or links to relevant work samples.

3. A brief introduction explaining why you are a strong fit for this role.

4. Examples of social media accounts you have managed and your specific responsibilities for each.

5. Any measurable results you helped achieve, such as increased reach, engagement, followers, inquiries, website traffic, or conversions.

6. The platforms and content tools you use confidently.

7. Your desired hourly or monthly rate.

8. Your weekly availability and the hours you can overlap with U.S. Central Time.

9. A description of how you would keep two brands with different audiences and personalities visually and strategically distinct.

10. The words **“Elevate the Brand”** at the beginning of your application so we know you read the entire posting.



Applications without both a resume and relevant portfolio or work samples will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a brief paid skills assessment involving content planning, branding, caption writing, or short-form video editing. Submitted materials will be used only for candidate evaluation and will not be published or used commercially without payment and permission.

title: Meta Ads Specialist (Full-Time) — GrowFactor Group
description:
About us



GrowFactor Group runs multiple UK businesses. This role starts with Vital Glow — a growing, nurse-led medical aesthetics and IV therapy clinic — and expands to running paid ads across our group of businesses (including GrowFactor) once you've proven yourself.



Vital Glow's Meta ads have worked well before (leads at £5–8 each). We want someone who lives and breathes paid ads — constantly building, testing, tweaking, and scaling — so we're always improving, never standing still.



The role



We're hiring a full-time Meta Ads specialist to own our paid acquisition. This is a hands-on, always-on role for someone who genuinely enjoys the daily craft of running ads: launching new creatives, killing losers, scaling winners, testing relentlessly.



How it works: You'll start focused 100% on Vital Glow through a paid trial period. Once you've shown you can deliver, the role expands to managing ads across the wider group (GrowFactor and others) — a full-time, long-term position with room to grow into a lead role.



What you'll own



Campaign management: Build, launch, and manage Meta lead-gen campaigns 
 + Instagram).

Constant testing & iteration: Always be adding new ads, testing hooks/creatives/audiences, and refining. We want momentum, not set-and-forget.



Optimisation: Monitor daily, manage budgets, kill underperformers, scale winners, drive down cost-per-qualified-lead.

You must have

GoHighLevel familiarity (our CRM — leads flow from ads into GHL).

Experience running ads across multiple brands/accounts at once.



Compensation



Paid trial period first, then long-term full-time.

Guaranteed on-time monthly payment. Paid leave. Real room to grow into a lead role as the group scales.

To apply — read carefully (applications that skip these steps won't be reviewed)

Tell us how you like to test and iterate - what does your weekly ads routine look like?

title: Homecare Caregiver recruiter
description:
We are a licensed home care agency serving seniors across South Central Minnesota. Our caregivers help older adults remain independent and safe in their own homes. As our service area continues to grow, we are hiring a full-time remote Recruiter who will take ownership of building and maintaining a steady pipeline of qualified caregivers. This role requires someone who understands that recruiting in home care is an operational function, not just a hiring activity. Your responsibility is to ensure the organization always has enough caregivers in the right cities so that seniors who need care can receive it without delay.



The recruiter will manage the full caregiver recruiting cycle, from attracting applicants to moving qualified candidates into the hiring process. You will actively manage job postings, communicate with applicants by phone, screen candidates, and maintain an organized recruiting pipeline. This role also requires close coordination with scheduling, HR, and leadership so that hiring activity matches the real staffing needs of the business. Success in this position means anticipating shortages before they happen and ensuring we always have caregivers available where demand exists.



This role involves a high level of daily communication with applicants and requires strong organization. You will review applicant flow, conduct structured phone screens, follow up with candidates who have incomplete applications, and ensure interviews are scheduled efficiently. You will also track recruiting metrics such as applicant volume, interview conversion, hires, and hiring trends by geographic area. The goal is to keep the recruiting pipeline healthy so the company can continue expanding services without staffing interruptions.



We are looking for someone who has at least two years of recruiting experience and is comfortable handling frequent phone conversations with applicants. Experience recruiting hourly workers, especially in healthcare or home care, is helpful but not required. Strong written and spoken English is essential, along with solid spreadsheet skills and the ability to stay organized while managing multiple applicants at different stages of the process.



The right candidate is reliable, calm under pressure, and focused on getting results. We value people who communicate clearly, take ownership of their work, and approach recruiting with a problem-solving mindset. If you apply for this position, please include the word Apollo somewhere in your response so we know you read the entire posting.
